name: GoogleFederatedAuth
description: Exchanges a federated OIDC token for a Google Cloud access token and sets the Google Cloud variables.
author: Slawomir Koszewski

inputs.name: serviceConnection
inputs.label: Azure Resource Manager service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: AzureRM service connection used to request the OIDC token. It is the OIDC issuer trusted by the Google workload identity provider, not a Google Cloud credential. Requires System.AccessToken to be available to the job.

inputs.name: gcpWorkloadIdentityProvider
inputs.label: Workload identity provider
inputs.helpMarkDown: Full resource name of the Google Cloud workload identity pool provider: `projects/<PROJECT_NUMBER>/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/<POOL>/providers/<PROVIDER>`, optionally prefixed with `//iam.googleapis.com/`. Use the project **number**, not the project ID.

inputs.name: gcpServiceAccountEmail
inputs.label: Service account to impersonate
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional service account email. When set, the federated token is used to impersonate this service account and the impersonated access token is the one handed to the pipeline. Requires roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser on the service account. When empty, the federated token is used directly (direct resource access).

inputs.name: gcpProjectId
inputs.label: Project ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional Google Cloud project ID. When set, the non-secret variable GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT is set, which the Terraform google provider and the Google Cloud client libraries read as the default project.

inputs.name: gcpRegion
inputs.label: Region
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional default region. When set, the non-secret variable GOOGLE_REGION is set, which the Terraform google provider reads as its default region.

inputs.name: gcpScopes
inputs.label: OAuth scopes
inputs.helpMarkDown: Whitespace or comma separated OAuth scopes for the issued access token. Defaults to https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform.

inputs.name: gcpAccessTokenVariable
inputs.label: Access token variable name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the secret pipeline variable that receives the Google Cloud access token. Defaults to GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN. The variable is secret, so later steps map it with `env:` under whatever name the tool expects, for example CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN for gcloud. The name may contain letters, digits, `.` and `_`, and must not start with the Azure DevOps reserved prefixes endpoint, input, secret, path or securefile.

inputs.name: gcpTokenLifetimeSeconds
inputs.label: Token lifetime (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional lifetime of the impersonated access token, in seconds. Applies only when a service account is impersonated. Leave empty for the API default of 3600. Values above 3600 require the service account to be covered by the constraints/iam.allowServiceAccountCredentialLifetimeExtension organization policy (maximum 43200).

inputs.name: gcpStsTokenUrl
inputs.label: Security Token Service URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Security Token Service endpoint used for the token exchange. Change this only to target a regional endpoint, for example https://sts.europe-west1.rep.googleapis.com/v1/token.

inputs.name: printOidcClaims
inputs.label: Print OIDC token claims to logs
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, prints the aud and exp claims of the Azure DevOps OIDC token. Use the audience to configure the Google workload identity provider's --allowed-audiences.

inputs.name: printTokenHashes
inputs.label: Print SHA256 token hashes to logs
inputs.helpMarkDown: When enabled, prints the SHA256 hash of the issued Google Cloud access token.
